arxiv-2108-11688.title: Time-dependent treatment of cosmic-ray spectral steepening due to turbulence driving Journal: ApJ
arxiv-2108-11688.creator: Martin Pohl
arxiv-2108-11688.description: Abstract Cosmic-ray acceleration at non-relativistic shocks relies on scattering by turbulence that the cosmic rays drive upstream of the shock. We explore the rate of energy transfer from cosmic rays to non-resonant Bell modes and the spectral softening it implies.

arxiv-2207-03751.title: Anisotropic Spatial Entanglement
arxiv-2207-03751.creator: Satyajeet Patil, Shashi Prabhakar, Ayan Biswas, Ashok Kumar, Ravindra P. Singh
arxiv-2207-03751.description: Abstract The photon-pairs generated through spontaneous parametric down-conversion (SPDC) possess strong correlations in their transverse position and momentum degrees of freedom. For such photon-pairs, the transverse position correlation length depends on the crystal thickness and the pump wavelength, whereas the transverse momentum correlation length depends on the beam waist and spatial coherence length of the pump.

arxiv-2302-04219.title: NewsComp: Facilitating Diverse News Reading through Comparative Annotation Conference: Proceedings of the 2023 CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems; April 23–28, 2023; Hamburg, Germany Proceedings of the 2023 CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems (CHI ’23), April 23–28
arxiv-2302-04219.creator: Md Momen Bhuiyan, Sang Won Lee, Nitesh Goyal, Tanushree Mitra
arxiv-2302-04219.description: Abstract . To support efficient, balanced news consumption, merging articles from diverse sources into one, potentially through crowdsourcing, could alleviate some hurdles. However, the merging process could also impact annotators’ attitudes towards the content. To test this theory, we propose comparative news annotation; that is, annotating similarities and differences between a pair of articles.

arxiv-2306-15077.title: Pion decay constraints on exotic 17 MeV vector bosons
arxiv-2306-15077.creator: Matheus Hostert, Maxim Pospelov
arxiv-2306-15077.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Matheus Hostert, Maxim Pospelov. We derive constraints on the couplings of light vector particles to all first-generation Standard Model fermions using leptonic decays of the charged pion, π + → e + ​ ν e ​ X μ \pi^{+}\to e^{+}\nu_{e}X_{\mu} .

arxiv-2311-12825.title: A PSO Based Method to Generate Actionable Counterfactuals for High Dimensional Data
arxiv-2311-12825.creator: Shashank Shekhar, Asif Salim, Vivaswan Jinturkar, Anirudha Nayak, Adesh Bansode
arxiv-2311-12825.description: Abstract Counterfactual explanations (CFE) are methods that explain a machine learning model by giving an alternate class prediction of a data point with some minimal changes in its features. It helps the users to identify their data attributes that caused an undesirable prediction like a loan or credit card rejection.

arxiv-2311-15943.title: Collinear laser spectroscopy of highly charged ions produced with an electron beam ion source
arxiv-2311-15943.creator: P. Imgram, K. König, B. Maaß, P. Müller, W. Nörtershäuser
arxiv-2311-15943.description: Abstract Collinear laser spectroscopy has been performed on He-like C 4+ ions extracted from an electron beam ion source (EBIS). In order to determine the transition frequency with the highest-possible accuracy, the lineshape of the fluorescence response function was studied for pulsed and continuous ion extraction modes of the EBIS in order to optimize its symmetry and linewidth.

arxiv-2312-11764.title: Floating active carpets drive transport and aggregation in aquatic ecosystems
arxiv-2312-11764.creator: G. Aguayo 1, A. J. T. M. Mathijssen 2, H. N. Ulloa 3, R. Soto 1 and F. Guzmán-Lastra 4
arxiv-2312-11764.description: Abstract Communities of swimming microorganisms often thrive near liquid-air interfaces. We study how such ‘active carpets’ shape their aquatic environment by driving biogenic transport in the water column beneath them. The hydrodynamic stirring that active carpets generate leads to diffusive upward fluxes of nutrients from deeper water layers, and downward fluxes of oxygen and carbon.

arxiv-2409-05951.title: The Role of Thermal Feedback in the Growth of Planetary Cores by Pebble Accretion in Dust Traps
arxiv-2409-05951.creator: Daniel P. Cummins, James E. OwenImperial Astrophysics, Imperial College London, Blackett Laboratory, Prince Consort Rd, London, SW7 2AZ, UK
arxiv-2409-05951.description: Abstract High-resolution millimetre-imaging of protoplanetary discs has revealed many containing rings and gaps. These rings can contain large quantities of dust, often in excess of 10 ​ M ⊕ 10M_{\oplus} , providing prime sites for efficient and rapid planet formation. Rapid planet formation will produce high accretion luminosities, heating the surrounding disc.

arxiv-2410-15109.title: Controlled diffusion processes in an adiabatic model of a bouncing ball
arxiv-2410-15109.creator: Valdir Barbosa da Silva Junior, Ana Laura Boscolo, Diogo Ricardo da Costa, Luiz Antonio Barreiro
arxiv-2410-15109.description: Abstract This study explores the integration of a diffusion control parameter into the chaotic dynamics of a modified bouncing ball model. By extending beyond simple elastic collisions, the model introduces elements that affect the diffusive behavior of kinetic energy, offering insights into the interplay between deterministic chaos and stochastic diffusion.

arxiv-2506-05878.title: A projection-based framework for gradient-free and parallel learning
arxiv-2506-05878.creator: Andreas Bergmeister
arxiv-2506-05878.description: Abstract We present a feasibility-seeking approach to neural network training. This mathematical optimization framework is distinct from conventional gradient-based loss minimization and uses projection operators and iterative projection algorithms. We reformulate training as a large-scale feasibility problem: finding network parameters and states that satisfy local constraints derived from its elementary operations.

arxiv-2507-05978.title: FineGrasp: Towards Robust Grasping for Delicate Objects
arxiv-2507-05978.creator: Yun Du, Mengao Zhao, Tianwei Lin, Yiwei Jin, Chaodong Huang, Zhizhong Su
arxiv-2507-05978.description: Abstract Recent advancements in robotic grasping have led to its integration as a core module in many manipulation systems. For instance, language-driven semantic segmentation enables the grasping of any designated object or object part. However, existing methods often struggle to generate feasible grasp poses for small objects or delicate components, potentially causing the entire pipeline to fail.

arxiv-2511-08671.title: JWST/NIRSpec Reveals a Small Population of Dominant Dust-Obscured Ionizing Sources in Galaxies at 1 < z < 3 1<z<3 Astropy ( Astropy Collaboration et al. 2013 ) , NumPy C. R. Harris et al. 2020 , Matplotlib ( J. D. Hunter 2007 )
arxiv-2511-08671.creator: Si-rui Ge (葛思瑞), Nikko J. Cleri, Joel Leja, Antonello Calabrò, Vital Fernández
arxiv-2511-08671.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Si-rui Ge (葛思瑞), Nikko J. Cleri, Joel Leja, Antonello Calabrò, Vital Fernández. Rest-frame optical emission line diagnostics are often used to help classify ionizing sources within galaxies. However, rest-frame optical tracers can miss sources with high dust attenuation, leading to misclassification of the dominant ionizing source. Longer wavelength tracers, such as those in the near-infrared, carry the power to diagnose ionizing sources while being more robust than optical tracers to the presence of dust.

pmc-10599725.description: The conserved autophagy transcription factor HLH-30/TFEB is a well-established modulator of lifespan in several mechanistically-distinct longevity paradigms in C. elegans. pmc-10605945.creator: Vincent Nguyen, Aaron Jackson, Jenna Gale
pmc-10605945.description: Research questionAre live birth rates affected in frozen embryo transfer cycles that develop transient endometrial cavity fluid that resolves by day of embryo transfer?DesignThe first frozen blastocyst transfer cycle between January 1st, 2016 and December 31st, 2019 were included in this retrospective cohort study at an academic fertility center.

pmc-11324744.title: Prediction of concrete compressive strength using a Deepforest-based model
pmc-11324744.creator: Wan Zhang, Jiangtao Guo, Cuiping Ning, Ruifang Cheng, Ze Liu
pmc-11324744.description: Concrete compressive strength testing is crucial for construction quality control. The traditional methods are both time-consuming and labor-intensive, while machine learning has been proven effective in predicting the compressive strength of concrete. However, current machine learning-based algorithms lack a thorough comparison among various models, and researchers have yet to identify the optimal predictor for concrete compressive strength.

pmc-11452520.title: MDM2 induces pro-inflammatory and glycolytic responses in M1 macrophages by integrating iNOS-nitric oxide and HIF-1α pathways in mice
pmc-11452520.creator: Kelvin Ka-lok Wu, Xiaofan Xu, Manyin Wu, Xiaomu Li, Moinul Hoque, Gloria Hoi Yee Li, Qizhou Lian, Kekao Long, Tongxi Zhou, Hailong Piao, Aimin Xu, Hannah Xiaoyan Hui, Kenneth King-yip Cheng
pmc-11452520.description: M1 macrophages induce protective immunity against infection, but also contribute to metabolic and inflammatory diseases. Here we show that the E3 ubiquitin ligase, MDM2, promotes the glycolytic and inflammatory activities of M1 macrophage by increasing the production of IL-1β, MCP-1 and nitric oxide (NO).

pmc-11661270.title: Paradoxical Agitation and Masseter Spasm During Propofol Procedural Sedation: A Case Report
pmc-11661270.creator: Amit S Padaki, Prabhdeep Uppal, Michael Perza
pmc-11661270.description: IntroductionPropofol is an anesthetic agent commonly used in emergency department (ED) procedural sedation. It is often preferred in orthopedic procedures because of its muscle-relaxing properties. Rarely, however, it can induce agitation and muscle hypertonicity.Case ReportA 58-year-old man presented to the ED with a left ankle fracture-dislocation. Propofol was used to facilitate procedural sedation, but the patient became mildly agitated.

pmc-12773530.description: IntroductionSeveral lines of evidence demonstrate the effectiveness of endovascular treatment (EVT) for large volume stroke (LVS) as defined by Alberta Stroke Program Early CT Score (ASPECTS) of <6 in decreasing severe disability and death. However EVT cannot improve the degree of disability as measured by modified Rankin Scale to be better than premorbid levels.

pmc-13134507.title: Small Cell Lung Cancer Establishes a Metabolic Autocrine Mechanism Through Active Extracellular ATP Transport
pmc-13134507.creator: Takeshi Tsuruda, Manabu Kodama, Keiichi I Nakayama
pmc-13134507.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Small cell lung cancer (SCLC) is an aggressive malignancy with a 5‐year survival rate of less than 7%. SCLC is characterized by accelerated de novo purine nucleotide biosynthesis, which fuels its rapid proliferation. While ATP serves as an essential metabolic substrate for nucleotide polymer synthesis and as the universal energy currency that fuels essential biological processes, it can also act as a potent extracellular signaling molecule.

pmc-13197456.title: Impacts of non-native invertebrates and plants on polar soil systems
pmc-13197456.creator: Octavia D M Brayley, Peter Convey, Sami Ullah, Scott A L Hayward
pmc-13197456.description: Invasive non-native species are amongst the most serious threats to biodiversity at local and global scales. Due to their geographical remoteness, extreme conditions and lower levels of human activity, the Earth’s polar regions have seen fewer invasions to date compared to temperate and tropical areas.

pmc-13240541.title: Prevalence, Characteristics, and Outcomes Associated With Early Vasculopathy in Patients With Chronic Lung Disease Undergoing Right Heart Catheterization
pmc-13240541.creator: Esteban Kosak Lopez, Andrew Geller, Raul Leguizamon, Justin Lam, Thitiphan Srikulmontri, Michael Vera Ricaurte, Maria Siqueira Tavares de Melo, Thomas Stavola, John Malin, Kevin Bryan Lo, Jose M Martinez‐Manzano, Enrique Pacheco, Zurab Azmaiparashvili
pmc-13240541.description: Pulmonary hypertension associated with chronic lung disease (PH‐CLD) meets precapillary PH criteria. Less is known CLD patients with “early vasculopathy,” a phenotype characterized by elevated pulmonary vascular resistance (PVR) and normal mean pulmonary artery pressure (mPAP). In this study, we aimed to determine the prevalence, characteristics, and outcomes of the early vasculopathy phenotype among CLD patients.

pmc-13521930.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). This multinational cone-beam computed tomography (CBCT) study evaluated the root canal morphology of mandibular first premolars (M1Ps) from 21 countries and compared how well the Ahmed and Vertucci classification systems represented these patterns. A total of bilateral mandibular first premolars from eligible CBCT scans were assessed using both systems, and the data were analyzed with a hierarchical probabilistic approach to account for population and imaging-related variation.

This study evaluated the efficacy and safety of PRT in adults with pilocytic astrocytoma.
